name: Flailpole
body:
Source Gnomes of Golarion pg. 22
Statistics
Cost 15 gp Weight 10 lbs.
Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical x2; Range —; Type B; Special disarm, reach, trip
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Exotic
Description
This is simply a heavy flail mounted on the end of a long polearm. It has the reach and trip weapon qualities.
